code:
Never paste into a third-party LLM prompt:
- real customer names, emails, SSNs, real PII
- API keys, connection strings, passwords, tokens
- unredacted production data of any kind
Instead: synthetic data, masked columns, schema-only
caption: A prompt is data leaving your control the moment you send it.
